author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Everyone knows Spider-Man. From Peter Parker to Miles Morales, the friendly neighborhood hero has become one of the most recognizable characters in pop culture history.

But long before the modern Spider-Verse movies, Marvel allowed Japan to create their own completely unique version of Spider-Man.

This version of Spider-Man wasn’t Peter Parker. Instead, the hero was Takuya Yamashiro, a motorcycle racer who gained powers from an alien warrior and fought an evil organization known as the Iron Cross Army.

Oh… and he also piloted a giant transforming robot.

title: The Most Unhinged Spider-Man Adaptation Ever Made
